data.exact_reserve_text: Net claims incurred includes prior accident year reserve release totaling GBP 1.6m (2014: GBP 4.1m release).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 2.422 million in 2015, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This was a result of mixed movements across older underwriting years, with some years showing releases and others strengthening. This figure contradicts the narrative text which states a net prior accident year reserve release of GBP 1.6 million. The overall technical result for the year was also noted to have benefited from a relatively benign catastrophe environment.

Prior year reserve movements resulted in a GBP 1.6m release

data.data_quality_notes: The narrative text on page 3 and note 7 on page 19 explicitly state a 'net prior accident year reserve release totaling GBP 1.6m'. However, the gross claims development triangle on page 14, when analyzed for years 2013 and prior, indicates a gross strengthening of GBP 2.422m. Per instructions, the gross triangle figure is used for 'prior_year_development_gbp_m' and 'direction', while the narrative text is copied verbatim for 'exact_reserve_text'.
